canonical_project: Ministry of Water Resources agricultural digital systems data center
owner: Ministry of Water Resources, Agriculture and Processing Industry / KOICA
notes: Open.kg reported a new data center opened to support agricultural-sector digital information systems, established with KOICA assistance for livestock-product traceability systems. The article did not disclose a precise locality; assigned to Bishkek because the relevant ministries and national digital platforms are based there, but locality and MW capacity are unverified.
